prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 22 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1174; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Records show long-standing treatment for the same condition before the crash; most of the current complaints come from it.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of neck and back pain. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported strain, and the force of the impact is in keeping with the soft tissue injuries described. Over the course of 22 visits, care included manual therapy, targeted exercise, and home program instruction. Treatment followed a typical progression and was gradually reduced as symptoms improved. On examination, some findings, including reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, support the reported injury, while other neurological and orthopedic tests were within normal limits. Prior records document ongoing care for similar neck and back complaints before this collision, and much of the current symptom burden appears to reflect that pre-existing condition rather than the recent event. Billing reviewed for this episode shows no duplicate or repeated charges. Ongoing recommendations include continued home exercise and reassessment if symptoms change.
